notes.title: Equipment Update 0.5.3
notes.content:
Added

 New Modifiers

 Critical Chance
 Experience Yield
 Damage Reduction (Reduce the damage taken)

 New Enemy

 Crow
Low health but very fast

 Player Equipment
Equip your character with new gear to enhance abilities and customize your playstyle. You can open the Character window by pressing the 'C' key.

 Player Statistics
You can also view Character stats in the Character window by pressing the 'C' key.

 Boss Drops
Defeating a Boss now rewards you with a unique item drop in different tiers!

 Blacksmith
New NPC in the Basecamp that sells basic equipment.

 Aim Direction Indicator
Added a visual indicator below the player to see the aim direction more clearly. Can be turned on/off in gameplay settings.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44136269/85a0e5325b71dde508b27b38574dad1606236f45.png

Enhancements & Changes

 First Realm Adjustments
Several waves in the First Realm have been reworked to provide a smoother progression and better challenge balance.

 Shaman Boss

 Reduced the melee attack range for a fairer fight against this powerful foe.
 Reduced health from 500 to 360

 Shop Items
Now has more detailed descriptions.

 Typo Fixes

 Special Abilitys" has been corrected to "Special Abilities".
 "Ulocking" has been corrected to "Unlocking".
 "Ablity" has been corrected to "Ability".

 NPC Dialog Improvement
Text from NPCs will now appear letter by letter, creating a more immersive reading experience.

 Key Tooltip

 Improved tooltip when player interacts with things in the basecamp.
 Added key tooltips to the UI elements in the basecamp like Vendor, Stash, Blacksmith etc.

 Rain of Fire
The starting area has been reduced by 10% for better balance.

notes.title: Optimization Patch 0.5.2
notes.content:
Fixes

 Fixed issue with baked culling, this will improve performance significantly
 Removed the grass shader due to issues on some graphics cards, but will look in to other grass solutions later on.
 Updated graphic settings. Low, Medium & High now has more distinct differences
 Capped framerate to 240fps


Other improvements

 Music now loops on Realm 1
 Cooldown modifier value is now correctly shown on the level up cards.
 Added projectile lives modifier to the Ice Bolt spell
 Fixed so Rain of Fire can't spawn outside the screen
 Added possibility to change color of the crosshair in gameplay settings

notes.title: Update 0.5.1
notes.content:
Spell Changes

 Improved damage modifier roll of Stone shot
 Improved damage modifier roll of Ice Bolt
 Improved damage modifier roll of Terra Shot
 Improved damage modifier roll of Haunt
 Improved damage modifier roll of Chain Lightning
 Added cooldown reduction modifier to Terra Shot
 Changed movement speed modifier to actually give 5% speed

Second Map Improvements

 Fixed collision issues
 Fixed issue with gates
 Visual improvements

Shop Upgrades

 Lowered Damage Multiplier amount
